Tip: Open CozyTing in split-screen or floating window beside Settings to type the port and 6-digit code directly:

• Why Accessibility instead of Overlay: Android 12+ / HyperOS hides regular overlays on Wireless Debugging screens. Enabling the CozyTing Pairing Helper shows a top keypad without overlay permission and auto-reads the 6-digit code.
• Notification Fallback: Without Accessibility, open \"Pair device with pairing code\", pull down the shade, and tap \"Enter 6-digit code\" (long-press or swipe down the notification if collapsed).
• After Reboot: Android turns off Wireless Debugging automatically. Just toggle Wireless Debugging back on—no re-pairing required.
• Watch Videos Without Interrupting Music: Android 13+ Single-App Silent Cast enables dual-zone audio focus isolation during casting, so short videos will not pause your speaker music.
• Wi-Fi Required: Both Wireless Debugging and LAN speaker casting require the same Wi-Fi network.
• Privacy Dot: Silent Mode removes cast prompts and banners; Android 12+ may still show a tiny system green audio privacy dot.
